## Slate overview
There are four Division Series games today, three of them elimination games:
- **Guardians at White Sox** (ALDS G3, 4:00 PM ET, TBS): CWS leads 2-0. CWS -120 / CLE +100, total 8. Both teams open with relievers: Daniel Espino for Cleveland, Sean Newcomb for Chicago ([SI](https://www.si.com/betting/guardians-vs-white-sox-prediction-odds-probable-pitchers-prop-bets-for-alds-game-3-2026)).
- **Dodgers at Braves** (NLDS G4, 6:00 PM ET, FS1): LAD leads 2-1 after a 3-1 Game 3 win behind Yamamoto's 10 strikeouts ([AJC](https://www.ajc.com/sports/2026/10/braves-dodgers-game-3-nlds/)). Glasnow (3.53 ERA) vs. Mahle (3.99), LAD about -144 ([SI](https://www.si.com/betting/dodgers-vs-braves-prediction-odds-probable-pitchers-prop-bets-for-nlds-game-4-2026)).
- **Rays at Yankees** (ALDS G3, 8:00 PM ET, TBS): TB leads 2-0. Max Fried vs. Nick Martinez. NYY -156 to -176 ([FanDuel Research](https://www.fanduel.com/research/yankees-vs-rays-mlb-odds-prediction-point-spread-over-under-and-betting-trends-alds-game-3-10-7-2026)).
- **Brewers at Padres** (NLDS G4, 10:00 PM ET): MIL leads 2-1 after San Diego won Game 3 4-3 ([Yahoo](https://sports.yahoo.com/mlb/live/brewers-padres-box-score-live-updates-starting-pitchers-news-highlights-stats-where-to-watch-nlds-game-3-003000644.html)). Robert Gasser vs. Walker Buehler. SD -113 / MIL -104, total 7.5.

Our MLB record is 1-1. Last night's Padres lean (passed) would have won.

## Best bets

### Brewers moneyline (-104) at Padres - 1 unit
- **Win probability 54.5% vs. 51.0% implied.**
- **San Diego is starting its weakest arm.** Walker Buehler finished with a 4.63 ERA and 1.35 WHIP. Robert Gasser (3.87 ERA, 1.19 WHIP, 22.2% K rate) is the better pitcher on paper, even with a 4.36 road ERA ([Yahoo](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/brewers-vs-padres-prediction-picks-160000007.html)).
- **Milwaukee's bullpen depth.** Pat Murphy has multi-inning lefties Robert Gasser and Shane Drohan and righty Chad Patrick lined up behind the starter ([SI](https://www.si.com/mlb/padres/onsi/padres-announce-starting-pitcher-must-win-nlds-game-4-brewers)). San Diego has to cover the late innings after using its bullpen heavily to survive Game 3.
- **The market is pricing San Diego's desperation**, not the pitching. San Diego, -136 last night with Pivetta, is still a home favorite with a worse starter.
- Bet it up to -115.

## Leans & passes
- **Dodgers -144 at Braves:** pass. Glasnow vs. Mahle is a moderate edge, and -144 already charges for it.
- **Yankees -162 vs. Rays:** pass. Fried at home in an elimination game should be favored, but -156 to -176 is about fair. New York made four errors in Game 2, and Martinez's stats differ by source (2.38 road ERA vs. 3.10 overall), so the price is unclear.
- **White Sox -120 vs. Guardians:** pass. Both teams are using bullpen games, so it's a coin flip with home field priced in. Lean under 8 (-116).

## Risks
- Elimination-game bullpen usage is unpredictable. A Padres closer used early could swing late innings either way.
- Prices came from search snippets. Confirm before betting.
